en: What internships does Tech Monster offer?
or: Tech Monster re keun internship achhi
mu keun internship re join kariparibi
Tech Monster kana internship offer kare
hi: Tech Monster par kaun kaun si internships available hain
main kaun si internship join kar sakta hoon
Tech Monster kaun si internships offer karta hai
mixed: Tech Monster re kaun se internship available achhi
mu kaun internship re join kariparibi

answers.en: Tech Monster currently provides the internships available in the Internships section of the platform. Open that section to see the current internship programs and their details.
answers.or: Tech Monster re currently available internship guda Internships section re dekhapariba. Sehi section open kari current internship program au details check kara.
answers.hi: Tech Monster par currently available internships Internships section mein milengi. Us section ko open karke current internship programs aur unki details check karein.
answers.mixed: Tech Monster re currently available internships Internships section re dekhapariba. Seithi internship program au details check kara.

en: How do I enroll in an internship?
How can I join an internship?
I want to join an internship
How can I start my internship?
or: mu internship re kemiti join karibi
hi: main internship join karna chahta hoon
mixed: main internship re kemiti join karibi

answers.en: Open the internship you want to join and use the enrollment option provided on the internship page. After successful enrollment, you can access it from your dashboard.
answers.or: Jahaku tume join karibaku chahucha sehi internship open kari internship page re thiba enrollment option use kara. Enrollment successful hele dashboard ru access karipariba.
answers.hi: Jis internship ko aap join karna chahte hain use open karein aur internship page par diya gaya enrollment option use karein. Successful enrollment ke baad dashboard se access kar sakte hain.
answers.mixed: Jaha internship re join karibaku chahucha taku open kari enrollment option use kara. Successful hele dashboard ru access karipariba.

en: What do I learn in an internship?
What is included in an internship?
What learning content does the internship have?
What can I do inside my internship?
or: internship re keun learning content achhi
hi: internship ke andar kya hota hai
internship mein kaunsa learning content hai
internship mein kya karna hota hai
mixed: internship re kaun learning content achhi

answers.en: The learning content depends on the selected internship. Your internship can include modules, lessons, practical tasks and other learning resources provided by Tech Monster.
answers.or: Learning content selected internship upare depend kare. Internship re modules, lessons, practical tasks au Tech Monster dwara provide kara jaithiba anya learning resources thae.
answers.hi: Learning content selected internship par depend karta hai. Internship mein modules, lessons, practical tasks aur Tech Monster ke dwara diye gaye anya learning resources ho sakte hain.
answers.mixed: Learning content selected internship upare depend kare. Modules, lessons, practical tasks au anya learning resources milipare.

en: How do I complete my internship?
What do I need to complete an internship?
How can I finish my internship?
What happens after I complete my internship?
hi: internship complete karne ke liye kya chahiye
internship complete hone ke baad kya hoga

answers.en: Complete the required lessons and tasks included in your internship and follow the progression requirements shown on the platform.
answers.or: Tumara internship re thiba required lessons au tasks complete kara au platform re dekhajauthiba progression requirements follow kara.
answers.hi: Apni internship mein diye gaye required lessons aur tasks complete karein aur platform par dikhaye gaye progression requirements follow karein.
answers.mixed: Internship re required lessons au tasks complete kari platform ra progression requirements follow kara.
